description: Add an event to a calendar. Required: title, start_at (ISO), end_at (ISO). Optional: user_id (defaults to caller), agent_id (omit = the user's own calendar), all_day, location, description, lead_id (links the appointment to a lead so it shows up on that record and in find_calendar_event), timezone (IANA; defaults to the calendar owner's). Times without an offset are read as wall-clock time in that zone. User-calendar events sync to Google if linked (→ phone); agent calendars are app-internal. Creates NO Teams/Meet link and invites nobody — for an appointment with a video link (Teams/Meet) in the host's Outlook/Google calendar use create_meeting with video_provider.

brain_id.description: Agent brain (category) this event belongs to.

recurrence_end.description: ISO date the series stops on. Omit for open-ended.

rrule.description: Recurrence rule, e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO'. Without this a series cannot be created at all — one entry stands for the whole series.

name: create_calendar_event
